# ScramUIBuilder

*Client*

Builds a script screen, created by `scram.ui()`: its methods add components (buttons, labels, text fields, forms and more), which are placed with their position and size methods; `c.getPlayer().openUI(ui)` shows the screen. Components with an ID can be found again by [`getComponent`](#getcomponent) and animated by [`animation`](#animation).

## Methods

### animation {#animation}

::: member

Animates a component: starts now and calls the function every frame until the time is over.

```js
ui.label("Hello").id("title");
ui.animation("title", "fade", "sine_out", 0.5, function (label, progress) {
    label.ry(progress * 0.3);
});
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `componentId` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | ID of the component given by [`id`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent#id) |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | animation ID, to cancel it or chain more with the returned system |
| `interpolation` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | BBS interpolation name, e.g. `"linear"` or `"sine_inout"` |
| `delay` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | duration in seconds |
| `consumer` | `Function<UIComponent<?>,Double>` | function called every frame with the component and the progress, 0 at the start and 1 at the end after the interpolation |

**Returns** [`UIAnimationSystem`](/scripting/client/ui/systems/UIAnimationSystem) — the animation, to chain more animations, repeat it or react to its end

:::

### animation {#animation-2}

::: member

Animates a component with linear progress, see [`animation(String, String, String, float, BiConsumer)`](#animation).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `componentId` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | ID of the component given by [`id`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent#id) |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | animation ID, to cancel it or chain more with the returned system |
| `delay` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | duration in seconds |
| `consumer` | `Function<UIComponent<?>,Double>` | function called every frame with the component and the progress, 0 at the start and 1 at the end after the interpolation |

**Returns** [`UIAnimationSystem`](/scripting/client/ui/systems/UIAnimationSystem) — the animation

:::

### animation {#animation-3}

::: member

Animates a component with linear progress and a random animation ID, see [`animation(String, String, String, float, BiConsumer)`](#animation).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `componentId` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | ID of the component given by [`id`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent#id) |
| `delay` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | duration in seconds |
| `consumer` | `Function<UIComponent<?>,Double>` | function called every frame with the component and the progress, 0 at the start and 1 at the end after the interpolation |

**Returns** [`UIAnimationSystem`](/scripting/client/ui/systems/UIAnimationSystem) — the animation

:::

### cancelAnimation {#cancelanimation}

::: member

Stops a running animation; the component keeps its current state and the end callback is not called.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `animationId` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | animation ID; unknown IDs are ignored |

:::

### button {#button-3}

::: member

Adds a button.

```js
ui.button("Close", function () {
    c.getPlayer().closeGUI();
}).rxy(0.5, 0.9).wh(80, 20).anchor(0.5);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | button text |
| `onClick` | `Function` | function called when the button is clicked, or null |

**Returns** [`UIButtonComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIButtonComponent) — the new button

:::

### overlay {#overlay}

::: member

Adds a panel that opens over the screen with [`open`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIOverlayComponent#open); its components are built at once by the function with a separate builder.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | title of the panel |
| `consumer` | `Function<ScramUIBuilder>` | function that adds the components of the panel to the builder it gets |

**Returns** [`UIOverlayComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIOverlayComponent) — the new overlay

:::

### layout {#layout}

::: member

Adds a group of components placed inside it, e.g. to move them together; they are built at once by the function with a separate builder, and their positions and sizes are relative to the group.

```js
ui.layout(function (layout, inner) {
    layout.xy(10, 10).wh(120, 60);
    inner.label("Inside").xy(5, 5);
}).id("panel");
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `consumer` | `Function<UILayoutComponent,ScramUIBuilder>` | function that gets the group and the builder of its components |

**Returns** `UILayoutComponent` — the new group

:::
